title: Not worth it for my dog
text: I foolishly did a 6 month subscription for a special cost and now I am stuck with it. My large dog is not a stuffed toy kind of dog and the first box had 3. CS is helpful though and they noted to decrease the stuffed toys. I only had 1 in the second box, but it is still a waste since she just ignores it. She normally likes most treats, but so far we are batting 50/50 with the ones received. I will cancel as soon as I can.
label: neutral
